title: own scope with NO targetEntity
why: An Action declares scope 'own' but never says what it operates on. 'own' is a filter over an ownership relation; with no target there is no relation to filter by, so the scope narrows nothing while presenting as the narrowest scope in the system. AZ7 requires that scope 'own' implies a declared targetEntity, so this manifest must fail validation and the App must not install.
notes: SCHEMA-DECIDABLE. The dependency is entirely within a single 'actions' item — 'if scope is own, then targetEntity is required' — which draft 2020-12 expresses with if/then inside $defs/action. No cross-array join is involved, so a schema failure here is a real schema failure and should be reported as one. NOTE THE PRE-AZ7 BEHAVIOUR: this manifest declares an entity that DOES carry ownershipField, so the manifest-level VAL-OWN clause is satisfied and the pre-AZ7 schema ACCEPTS it. The accept-to-reject flip on this fixture is the direct evidence that AZ7 closed the gap.
